gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-basel.description:
Current main 33074daf7: same-host SQLite baseline against ext4 on virtio-pmem; unprofiled, three iterations, before further optimizations.

Iterations: 3. Cases: bench-fs-ext4-dax-pmem bench-fs-fxfs-guest-dax. Workloads: sqlite.

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description:
First append-allocation candidate: sustained appends reserve up to 16 pages without advancing EOF; three unprofiled SQLite iterations on the baseline host. Includes all recovery, integrity, payload and snapshot checks.

Iterations: 3. Cases: bench-fs-fxfs-guest-dax. Workloads: sqlite.

Candidate 2 experiment: append reservation plus bounded sequential overwrite COW preserving every lookahead byte, clone data and mapped-reader coherence. Same host, Fxfs then ext4, full unprofiled SQLite group with correctness checks.

Iterations: 3. Cases: bench-fs-fxfs-guest-dax bench-fs-ext4-dax-pmem. Workloads: sqlite.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: discarded: overwrite lookahead increased checkpoint cost

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description: Experimental negotiated stage replacement; immutable append-only candidate1 kernel. Same host, reverse case order. Compare full SQLite including checkpoints; retain unfavorable outcomes.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: build failed: missing control-API counter fields

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description: Experimental negotiated stage replacement; immutable append-only candidate1 kernel. Same host, reverse case order. Prior candidate3 directory records compile failure; proto counter plumbing fixed. Full SQLite checkpoints and all correctness checks retained.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: discarded: server-side replacement added no throughput gain

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description:
Candidate4: append reservation plus extent-result buffers sized to covered logical pages rather than 512 entries. Root stage experiment reverted. Same-host full SQLite comparison, Fxfs then ext4, correctness checks unchanged.

Iterations: 3. Cases: bench-fs-fxfs-guest-dax bench-fs-ext4-dax-pmem. Workloads: sqlite.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: build failed: test snapshot had a stats type error

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description: Candidate4 retry after correcting test stats typing: same immutable kernel da4cfc183fa14ac44dae125e4945221df0fbd88ac71d9aea56fb1351ca11395e. Append reservation plus extent buffers sized to covered pages. Root stage experiment reverted. Same-host full SQLite, all recovery/integrity/payload/snapshot checks retained.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: retained: smaller extent buffers; allocation reduction, no throughput claim

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description: Candidate5 experiment: client peeks only complete adjacent exact stage replacements already in socket; no daemon queue or new wire kind. ACK retains original UNMAP ID. Immutable C4 kernel, Fxfs then ext4, full SQLite with correctness checks. Temporary power-of-two logs confirm actual use; remove before retaining code.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: discarded: client replacement did not close gaps; usage unconfirmed with INFO disabled

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.description: Candidate6: combine only adjacent complete acknowledged UNMAP headers already waiting, at most64 per operation. Union includes no gaps; ACK max ID of consumed UNMAPs only. No wait, no new protocol, no replacement. C5 discarded. Immutable C4 kernel; full SQLite correctness and same-host ext4.

Candidate7 batch: C6 adjacent unmap batching extended to same-permission protections with matching ACK flags; cached DAX reads retain lookup lock, skip redundant LRU movement and empty wakeups using wq_has_sleeper barrier. C4buffer sizing and C1append reservation retained. Temporary per-kind logs. Same host full SQLite and correctness checks.

Iterations: 3. Cases: bench-fs-fxfs-guest-dax bench-fs-ext4-dax-pmem. Workloads: sqlite.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-candi.outcome: protection batching discarded: no protection batches observed; cached-read kernel retained

gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-final.description: Quiet final candidate8: C1append reservation, C4covered-page extent buffers, C7cached-read bookkeeping and C6UNMAP-only batching. No protection peeks, no direct replacement, no diagnostic logs. Immutable C7kernel0f0eaeb5f4937cb62234e90fbb19e7afcdc36f18d5147373f424f0c455965784. Reverse case order ext4 thenFxfs, five iterations with all correctness checks.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-final.outcome: retained batch; final macOS and Linux workspace, Shuttle, Python and 11 guest cases passed; temporary instance and disk deleted and independently audited. Remaining performance gaps are recorded in summary.json.

Three full SQLite iterations; original frozen daemon/VMM and original kernel, current identical timed runner/guest agent. All recovery, integrity, payload and snapshot checks retained. See binaries.txt and frozen-host.sh.
gce-fs-bench-sqlite-gap-2026-10-25-final.outcome: fresh original-main binaries and kernel; identical current timed harness
